Pricing Methodology & Revenue Management Guide

How the pricing engine works, why it prevents underpricing, and how to communicate adjustments to Kivoya.

🔗 1. Zero-Scraping Kivoya PMS Ingestion

We connect directly to Kivoya's underlying Streamline VRS AJAX API:

GetPropertyAvailabilityCalendarRawData pulls all reservations and blocked periods for Unit 503802 in clean JSON.

GetPropertyRatesRawData pulls your exact seasonal rate schedule. We never guess your current rate or rely on flaky web scrapers for your home.

⚖️ 2. Apples-to-Apples Live Airbnb Guest Checkout Pricing

Guests on Airbnb evaluate Total Stay Cost (Base + Cleaning Fee + Channel Markup + Service Fee), not internal PMS rates.

We scrape Villa del Sol's actual guest checkout price directly from Airbnb (e.g. $693.50/night for Sep 6–10) rather than relying solely on internal Kivoya rates ($499 base + $500 clean = $624/night). This captures Streamline VRS / Kivoya OTA distribution markups, ensuring that our market percentiles, comp rankings, and subtable comparisons are 100% apples-to-apples against competitor Airbnb listings.

When computing your recommended PMS rate, we factor in the OTA markup so your adjustment in Kivoya accurately hits the Airbnb target:

Target Kivoya Total = (Target Airbnb Stay Total) ÷ Channel Factor
Rec Base Rate = (Target Kivoya Total − $500 Clean) ÷ Nights

📉 3. Dynamic Lead-Time Tapering Curve & Midweek Discount

Villa del Sol is a luxury resort compound (gated ¾-acre, heated pool/grotto, basketball court, putting green, casita). We benchmark against the top 20%–25% of luxury comps on weekends, while applying a 30% lower target percentile midweek to drive weekday occupancy where competitor pricing rarely adjusts:

  • Weekend Targets:
    • > 180 Days Out: 82nd Percentile (Capture early high-intent planners at top-dollar).
    • 60 – 180 Days Out: 78th Percentile (Standard booking window).
    • 30 – 60 Days Out: 72nd Percentile (Tapering to encourage booking).
    • < 30 Days Out: 65th Percentile (Protect occupancy for near-term dates).
  • Midweek Targets (30% Competitive Discount):
    • > 180 Days Out: 57.4th Percentile (0.82 × 0.70).
    • 60 – 180 Days Out: 54.6th Percentile (0.78 × 0.70).
    • 30 – 60 Days Out: 50.4th Percentile (0.72 × 0.70).
    • < 30 Days Out: 45.5th Percentile (0.65 × 0.70) to win bookings in slow midweeks.

📋 4. Action Guide & Priority Thresholds

Priority tiers indicate how urgently rates should be adjusted in Kivoya's Streamline PMS rate manager:

  • 🚨 Urgent Action (> 35% Discrepancy): Major market gap requiring immediate rate adjustment this week (filter with 1-click using '🚨 Urgent Action Only').
  • ⚠️ Moderate Review (10% – 35% Discrepancy): Review during monthly rate refreshes.
  • ✅ On Target (0% – 10% Discrepancy): Normal competitive range — cell left empty (no rate change needed).
  • Action Indicators:
    • ↓ Reduce base $X → $Y (-Z%) (Full Red Text): Price is above target effective cost; lower Kivoya base rate.
    • ↑ Increase base $X → $Y (+Z%) (Full Green Text): Price is below target effective cost; raise Kivoya base rate to capture revenue.

📊 5. Understanding 'N' (Comps Count) & Sold-Out Alerts

The Comps (N) column tracks how many comparable properties are available for each specific date:

  • High N (N ≥ 15): Robust available inventory in the market. High statistical significance for percentiles.
  • Low N (N ≤ 4): 🔥 Near Sold Out / Market Compression Alert: When N is very low, almost all direct competitors are already booked (e.g. Phoenix Open, Spring Training, major conventions).
  • Action on Low N: Do not discount! Your pricing power is at its peak. Hold rates high or increase them as remaining guests scramble for scarce inventory.
